item.title: Iran's supreme leader Khamenei killed in massive US and Israeli attack
item.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader since 1989 and sworn enemy of the West, was killed in the opening salvo of a massive US and Israeli attack that extended into a second day Sunday, as the two powers seek to topple the Islamic republic. Iranian state television confirmed Khamenei's death early Sunday, hours after President Donald Trump announced the killing of the 86-year-old cleric he described as "one of the most evil people in History." item.title: Iran president, 2 officials to lead transition after Khamenei's death: State TV
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and two top other officials will lead Iran in the transitional period following the death of supreme leader Ali Khamenei, state television reported on Sunday.Judiciary chief Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei and another official from the country's legal council will be part of the trio overseeing the transition, according to state television which cited Mohammad Mokhber, one of Khamenei's advisors.

item.title: Iran announces 40 days of mourning
item.description: Iran state television announced a 40-day mourning period and seven public holidays following the death of supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who had been in power since 1989.With the martyrdom of the supreme leader, his path and mission neither will be lost nor will be forgotten, on the other hand, they will be pursued with greater vigour and zeal," a presenter said.

item.title: Oil and gas majors and traders suspend shipments via Hormuz
item.description: Some oil majors and top trading houses have suspended crude oil, fuel and liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipments via the Strait of Hormuz as the US and Israel attack Iran and Tehran retaliates, four trading sources said on Saturday."Our ships will stay put for several days," one top executive at a major trading desk said.The tanker association INTERTANKO said the US Navy had warned against navigation in the operations area - the whole of the Gulf, Gulf of Oman, North Arabian Sea, and the Strait o

item.title: Khamenei’s daughter, son-in-law, grandson also killed
item.description: Iranian state media say Khamenei’s daughter, son-in-law, and grandson were also killed in the US and Israel’s ongoing attacks on the country, reports Al Jazeera.Meanwhile, the BBC’s media partner CBS News, citing intelligence and military sources, reported that about 40 Iranian officials were killed in the attacks.

item.title: Pakistan edge Sri Lanka in high-scoring thriller as both bow out of T20 WC

item.title: 10 Middle East flights cancelled at Ctg airport
item.description: Shah Amanat International Airport authorities cancelled 10 international flights on Sunday morning amid the ongoing conflict.The airport authorities confirmed the matter in a press release.Flights from Bangladesh to several Middle Eastern destinations have remained suspended since Saturday afternoon after several countries in the region temporarily closed their airspace following US and Israeli strikes on Iran and Tehran’s retaliation.

item.title: Iran attacked more than 20 US bases: IRGC
item.description: Iran delivered strikes against 27 US military bases in the region, the headquarters of the Israel Defense Forces and a defense complex in Tel Aviv, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said in a special statement.IRGC "will not allow sirens to become silent" in the territory of Israel and at US bases and will make "an even stronger attack against enemy facilities and targets," the statement indicates, cited by Iranian television.

item.title: Minister Amir Khosru hospitalised with pneumonia
item.description: Finance and Planning Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury has been admitted to United Hospital with pneumonia.According to his personal officer Shahiduzzaman, the minister is currently undergoing treatment at the United Hospital.His physical condition is now better than before, he added.
